export function settle(hold: Hold, usage: Usage): Settlement {
	const cost = priceOf(usage, hold.rates);
	if (cost > hold.amount) return { posted: hold.amount, shortfall: cost - hold.amount };
	return { posted: cost, shortfall: 0 };
}

	return { posted: cost, shortfall: 0 };
}
